description: This PHP source file provides a web-based configuration interface for local IP settings, including IPv4 and IPv6 configurations for a network gateway device. It includes server-side PHP code to fetch current network settings, and embedded JavaScript to manage user interactions, form validation, and AJAX calls to apply configuration changes.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Function to retrieve configuration or status string values for network settings.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Function to retrieve network parameter values given a parameter key.

methods.name: getInstanceIds
methods.description: Function to get instance IDs for IPv6 addresses.
